approval_quote: 同意，仅安装 JTAG B 接口驱动
scope: Use existing vendor-package Zadig to replace only FT4232 JTAG B / Interface 1 driver with libusbK, then configure Programmer USB Target and JTAG mode.
impact: Interface B ceases using the FTDI serial driver; the other interfaces retain their existing drivers. No FPGA or Flash programming is authorized by this approval.
rollback: Use Device Manager to restore the existing FTDI USB Serial Converter driver for Interface B, or reinstall the previously present FTDI driver for that interface.
